家里东西坏了，怎么报修才少跑一趟？: Something Broken at Home? How to Request a Repair Without an Extra Trip
先判断紧急程度，再准备型号、现象和可核对的报价: Assess urgency first, then gather model details, symptoms, and a checkable quote
把“坏了”变成维修人员能判断的信息：安全边界、照片与型号、适用承包商核验、报价拆: Turn “it's broken” into information a repair person can use: immediate safety, photos and model numbers, applicable contractor checks, itemized quotes, and completion records.

疑似燃气泄漏时先撤离，到安全位置联系紧急服务和公用事业公司。: If you suspect a gas leak, leave first. Contact emergency services and the utility company from a safe location.
按执照号码或经营名称核对执照状态及公开披露信息。: Check license status and public disclosures by license number or business name.
按相同工作范围比较书面报价，并核对身份和保险资料。: Compare written quotes for the same scope and check identification and insurance details.
好的报修说明不是先猜零件坏在哪里，而是让对方知道发生了什么、目前是否安全、到场需: A useful repair request describes what happened, whether it's currently safe, and what the technician should prepare—not a guess at the broken part. An error code or photo of a model label often helps more than “the motor must be broken.” The steps below are for routine home repairs. Address safety first if there's danger.
遇到危险，停止排查和等待报价: If there's danger, stop troubleshooting and waiting for quotes
疑似燃气泄漏先离开现场: Suspect a gas leak? Leave the area first
PG&E 的安全指南要求：闻到燃气味或怀疑泄漏时，立即远离现场，到安全位置拨打: PG&E's safety guidance says that if you smell gas or suspect a leak, leave immediately, call 911 from a safe location, then contact PG&E if you are in its service area. Avoid ignition sources, and don't stay to take photos, repeatedly test equipment, or locate the leak. If you see smoke, sparks, or water near exposed wires, stop using or taking apart the equipment. Contact emergency services if there is immediate danger.
用现象、时间线和型号描述问题: Describe symptoms, the timeline, and the model
在安全情况下，记录设备品牌、型号、错误代码、问题第一次出现的时间，以及持续发生还: When safe, record the brand, model, error code, when the problem started, and whether it's constant or intermittent. “It stops during draining and displays a code” is more accurate than assuming the pump failed. Photograph the whole unit, affected area, and model label. Don't remove protective covers or recreate a dangerous problem to record a video. Hide your home address, order numbers, and similar information before posting publicly.
写出已经观察到的现象与采取过的操作；不确定的部分直接标注“不确定”。: Write down what you've observed and what you've already tried. Mark anything you're unsure about as "uncertain."
查找购买记录和保修资料，先问厂家指定的维修渠道是否适用，避免重复预约。: Find purchase and warranty records, then ask whether the manufacturer's authorized repair option applies to avoid duplicate bookings.
租住住房时先向房东或物业报修，保留通知时间，问清谁安排进场、谁批准费用。: If you rent, report the issue to your landlord or property manager first. Keep the notification time and ask who arranges access and who approves costs.
核验服务方，也核验工作范围: Check the provider and the scope of work
家电检修和建筑系统施工，可能适用不同要求。需要承包商执照的项目，用 CSLB 官: Appliance repairs and work on building systems may have different requirements. If the project requires a contractor's license, use CSLB's official lookup to check the business name, number, status, and classification—not just a screenshot saying “licensed.” If you're unsure whether a license or permit is required, describe the work to CSLB or the local building department. CSLB's consumer guide also recommends checking who actually arrives and their insurance information. Platform profiles and reviews do not replace these checks.
把诊断费和维修费拆开问: Ask about diagnostic and repair fees separately
先问上门或诊断收费、能否抵扣后续维修、人工和零件分别如何计算，以及找不到故障或缺: Ask first about the callout or diagnostic fee, whether it credits toward a repair, how labor and parts are priced, and what happens if the fault cannot be found or parts are unavailable. For applicable contracting work, CSLB recommends getting multiple written quotes for the same scope. Write down that extra work needs your approval first, who buys parts, what happens to old parts, and estimated arrival times. An estimate is only an estimate, and don't assume a same-day repair.
完工后，留下别人接手也看得懂的记录: After the work, keep records another technician could understand
请维修人员说明查到的故障、实际处理内容与更换零件，保存工单和型号。: Ask the technician to explain the fault they found, the work performed, and parts replaced. Keep the work order and model information.
对方说安全后，请他演示相关功能，看原来的问题还在不在。: Once the provider says it is safe, have them demonstrate the relevant functions and check whether the original problem is gone.
记录尚未解决的问题、使用限制、下次到场条件和双方商定的后续安排。: Record unresolved issues, usage restrictions, conditions for another visit, and the follow-up both parties agreed on.
保存报价、追加项目的同意记录、收据及保修说明，问清保修范围、期限和联系渠道。: Keep the quote, the record of approvals for extra work, receipts, and warranty information. Ask about warranty coverage, duration, and contact details.
